finding: Two correctness issues found during 10-point audit (RC-3 + retry defect). (1) RC-3: status-bucketing exception handler at line 513 swallows exceptions silently with no log output — 'except Exception: st = ""' gives zero visibility when a JSON re-read fails at commit time. (2) _git_push_with_retry() calls 'git pull --rebase' but never checks the return code — if the rebase fails mid-conflict, the working tree is left in a mid-rebase state for the next push attempt. The abort path for a rebase failure was also missing entirely. Fix: check rebase return code, call 'git rebase --abort' (no-op if fetch failed before rebase started), log the failure, and continue to the next retry — all 3 push attempts preserved.
